post: We report a pre-registered [11C]UCB-J PET sub-study of a recently published randomized trial in which a single psilocybin dose produced rapid and sustained antidepressant effects in major depressive disorder (MDD).
snippet: We report a pre-registered [11C]UCB-J PET sub-study of a recently published randomized trial in which a single psilocybin dose produced rapid and sustained antidepressant effects in major depressive disorder (MDD). Synaptic loss has been implicated in MDD, and psychedelics induce synaptic remodeling in preclinical models within 24 hours, raising the possibility that psilocybin's antidepressant effects involve increased synaptic density. We used the PET radioligand [11C]UCB-J targeting synaptic v
title: Rapid antidepressant effects of psilocybin without increased SV2A binding: baseline binding predicts response

post: Serotonergic psychedelics reliably alter affective tone, emotional regulation, and self-experience. Prevailing theories emphasize acute changes in neural entropy, default mode network integrity, and large-scale functional connectivity but do not offer a clear mechanism that explains how 5-HT2A receptor pharmacology relates to lasting changes in affect and self-related processing.
snippet: Abstract Serotonergic psychedelics reliably alter affective tone, emotional regulation, and self-experience. Prevailing theories emphasize acute changes in neural entropy, default mode network integrity, and large-scale functional connectivity but do not offer a clear mechanism that explains how 5-HT2A receptor pharmacology relates to lasting changes in affect and self-related processing. This article addresses this gap by proposing a testable mechanistic framework in which serotonergic modulati
title: Psychedelic modulation of excitation–inhibition balance and the Affective Core Self: A multilevel mechanistic framework

post: A recent publication by Xu et al. suggests that Gi activation following 5-HT2AR stimulation differentiates hallucinogenic from nonhallucinogenic agonists. Here, we reanalyze the author's source data to demonstrate that Gi activation is less predictive of hallucinogenic potential than canonical effectors of 5-HT2AR signaling.
snippet: A recent publication by Xu et al. suggests that Gi activation following 5-HT2AR stimulation differentiates hallucinogenic from nonhallucinogenic agonists. Here, we reanalyze the author's source data to demonstrate that Gi activation is less predictive of hallucinogenic potential than canonical effectors of 5-HT2AR signaling.
title: Gi Signaling Does Not Differentiate Hallucinogenic from Nonhallucinogenic 5-HT2A Receptor Agonists.

post: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is characterized by dysfunction in higher-order cortical regions involved in emotional and cognitive processes; however, its neurobiological basis remains unclear. Pharmacological treatments, including esketamine and sertraline, produce rapid antidepressant effects.

post: The serotonin 5-HT 2A receptor (5-HT 2A R) signaling involves canonical G q/11 proteins and alternative pathways, such as recruitment of other G proteins. It has been proposed that the 5-HT 2A R-mediated activation of inhibitory G i/o proteins accounts for the hallucinogenic properties of psychedelics.

post: Ketamine exerts rapid antidepressant effects in treatment-resistant depression (TRD), but its impact on working memory and neural circuitry remains unclear. This secondary analysis investigated behavioral and neural changes during a working memory task post-ketamine infusion in TRD participants versus healthy volunteers (HVs).

post: Preprocessing of Positron Emission Tomography (PET) data can be performed in many different ways and often involves manual steps, resulting in reduced comparability across analyses and pipelines.
snippet: Background Preprocessing of Positron Emission Tomography (PET) data can be performed in many different ways and often involves manual steps, resulting in reduced comparability across analyses and pipelines. Apps working on PET data organized according to the Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) seek to automate preprocessing, enabling the application of standardized pipelines that increase comparability and reproducibility. In this study, two of these apps were validated against in-house software
title: A Comparison and Validation of BIDS Apps for Preprocessing of [ 11 C]UCB-J PET data

post: Voxel-level kinetic modeling in total-body dynamic positron emission tomography (TB-PET) enables precise physiological quantification but complicates parameter uncertainty estimation. While generative consistency models (CMs) can rapidly estimate Bayesian posterior distributions, they are constrained by type of tracers, kinetic models, and protocols.
snippet: Voxel-level kinetic modeling in total-body dynamic positron emission tomography (TB-PET) enables precise physiological quantification but complicates parameter uncertainty estimation. While generative consistency models (CMs) can rapidly estimate Bayesian posterior distributions, they are constrained by type of tracers, kinetic models, and protocols. Training them from scratch whenever a new tracer, model or protocol is used can be computationally intensive. To address this, we introduce LoRACM,
title: A General-Purpose Adaptable Foundation Model for Total-Body PET Kinetic Modelling.

post: Linking molecular mechanisms with large-scale brain dynamics remains a fundamental challenge in computational psychiatry. Receptor-informed whole-brain models have provided mechanistic insights into pharmacological interventions, yet they have largely relied on single-receptor topographies that cannot explain the collective response of multiple receptor systems.

post: Alzheimer’s disease arises from interacting amyloid, tau, and neurodegenerative processes, and is associated with large-scale network dysfunction and reduced brain dynamics complexity. However, it remains unclear whether disease progression alters the causal hierarchical organisation of large-scale brain dynamics.
snippet: Abstract Alzheimer’s disease arises from interacting amyloid, tau, and neurodegenerative processes, and is associated with large-scale network dysfunction and reduced brain dynamics complexity. title: Disruptions in brain hierarchical organisation reveal Alzheimer's disease progression

post: Semantic processing relies on flexible interactions between specialized lexico-semantic regions and domain-general control networks, particularly under challenging conditions. Using transcranial magnetic stimulation interleaved with functional magnetic resonance imaging, we investigated acute network adaptation when the left posterior middle temporal gyrus-a core lexico-semantic region-was perturbed during lexico-semantic decisions in 25 healthy participants.

post: Treatment-resistant depression (TRD) is a refractory form of major depressive disorder (MDD) for which conventional antidepressant strategies are often insufficient. Transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) has demonstrated clinical efficacy in TRD, but its biological mechanisms remain incompletely understood.

post: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a high-temporal-resolution, noninvasive window into some of the abnormalities underlying Parkinson's disease (PD), yet reported electrophysiological biomarkers vary widely across studies due to differences in preprocessing, feature extraction, and analytical pipelines.

post: Self-disturbance is a core feature of schizophrenia (SCZ) and may emerge during the prodromal phase. Temporal imprecision has recently been proposed as a core neural mechanism in schizophrenia, primarily demonstrated in faster EEG frequency ranges.
snippet: Abstract Self-disturbance is a core feature of schizophrenia (SCZ) and may emerge during the prodromal phase. Whether such imprecision extends to infraslow brain dynamics in functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) and relates to self-disturbance in early psychosis remains unknown. title: Temporal imprecision of the self in drug-free psychosis: Abnormal infraslow phase dynamics and brain complexity

title: Anesthesia via Dissociative Overload: A Unified Theoretical Framework Linking DMT and Ketamine Through Sigma-1 Convergence, Entropic Saturation, and Workspace Flooding

post: Ketamine produces rapid antidepressant effects in treatment-resistant depression (TRD), but these benefits diminish within days. post: Nitrous oxide (N 2 O) abuse has emerged as an increasingly serious public health concern, yet effective interventions for N 2 O dependence remain lacking.
snippet: Nitrous oxide (N 2 O) abuse has emerged as an increasingly serious public health concern, yet effective interventions for N 2 O dependence remain lacking.
